projects.title: Emotive AI  'Album Storyteller'
projects.outcome:
Enhanced User Experience through Iteration:
Led usability testing with approximately 30 users, identifying 4 critical bugs and successfully resolving 2 to significantly enhance application stability and user flow.

Pioneered Seamless AI-Driven Hybrid Application Integration:
Successfully engineered the integration of a laboratory-developed AI engine (Image-to-Text) into a hybrid application, delivering an emotive user interface that uniquely merges advanced AI with user-centric design principles.

Streamlined Memory Capture & Drastically Enhanced Efficiency:
By designing and implementing a core, intuitive feature, I drastically improved user convenience and efficiency, enabling the one-click generation of personalized, emotive stories from just 5 selected photos.

Successfully Delivered Core Value of Memory Preservation:
Empowered users to effortlessly record and cherish daily memories and significant moments as rich, automatically generated stories paired with photos, thereby fulfilling the project's central objective of fostering deeper personal connections to their past.
projects.description:
The 'Emotive AI 'Album Storyteller'' is a hybrid application conceptualized to offer a relaxed, everyday feel, seamlessly integrating into users' daily routines. This design philosophy was shaped through thorough research and analysis of existing storytelling applications, ensuring an intuitive yet unique approach to memory preservation. The project directly addresses the common challenge of conveniently and quickly recording daily life and significant moments with personalized stories.

Built with a distinctive emotive user interface, the application integrates a proprietary laboratory-developed AI engine (Image-to-Text), enabling users to effortlessly generate narratives. Specifically, by selecting just five images from Google Photos and with a single click, the application automatically crafts an emotive story closely related to the chosen photographs. This approach leverages advanced AI to provide an intuitive and deeply personal storytelling experience, empowering users to record their memories with unprecedented ease and emotional depth.
process: Competitive & Conceptual Research /  User Flow Analysis (Usability-Focused)
User Flow Design & Interaction Design (Usability & Efficiency Focused)
API Research & Integration (Google Photos API & Proprietary AI Engine)
projects.challenges:
Managing AI-Generated Content Inconsistency for User Satisfaction

The Problem: The proprietary AI engine exhibited inherent variability, where even identical image sets could yield inconsistent story tones or content. This risked undermining users' expectation for a cohesive emotive narrative and potentially led to dissatisfaction with unintended story outcomes.

Approach & Solution:
[UX Design] To address the AI's output variability and ensure user satisfaction, we designed a user flow that provided critical control mechanisms. If the initial generated story was not satisfactory, users were given the option to cancel and immediately regenerate a new narrative. Additionally, for those who wished to refine a story further or retain a specific version, a 'Save' option enabled subsequent editing of the generated content, ensuring flexibility in managing AI output.

Outcome & Learning: This approach successfully mitigated the limitations of AI-generated content by empowering users with flexible options for regeneration and post-creation refinement, effectively bridging the gap between technological capabilities and desired user experience.

Securing & Optimizing Google Photos API Integration for User Trust

The Problem: Integrating the Google Photos API presented substantial complexities in user authentication, data authorization, and efficient handling of large image volumes. Suboptimal implementation could lead to critical security vulnerabilities, erode user trust, and compromise service stability.

Approach & Solution:
[Technical Implementation] An optimized OAuth 2.0 authentication flow was implemented following in-depth analysis of the Google Photos API documentation. We strategically leveraged social login to minimize the exposure of sensitive user information. Furthermore, we dedicated efforts to developing efficient and aesthetically pleasing image loading screens, ensuring a seamless user experience during content retrieval.
[UX Design] To build user confidence, clear and reassuring messaging alongside comprehensive guidelines regarding data access permissions were thoughtfully integrated into the initial authorization request screens.

Outcome & Learning: This process deepened our expertise in navigating complex authentication protocols, achieving stable external API integration, and concurrently upholding robust user data security standards while delivering an optimal user experience.

Optimizing Visual Content Display for Emotive Storytelling

The Problem: Integrating user images for AI story generation faced a critical UX challenge: visually distorted images or unwanted empty spaces significantly degraded user emotional connection and satisfaction. Ensuring visual integrity – within a consistent, fully filled display – was paramount for delivering a genuine emotive experience.

Approach & Solution:
[UX Design] Implemented clear visual feedback by prominently displaying selected images at the top, enhancing user confidence in the AI processing and preventing unexpected visual outcomes.
[Efficient Frontend] Achieved robust visual consistency despite various image sizes using a CSS-based solution (uniform dimensions, object-fit: cover). This method precisely prevented visual distortion and empty spaces, employing strategic, controlled cropping to maintain an aesthetically pleasing, fully-filled layout without complex user adjustments.

Outcome & Learning: Successfully maximized user satisfaction by prioritizing visual clarity and distortion-free presentation through efficient frontend design, ensuring the visual integrity critical for emotive storytelling.

projects.title: AI-Driven Explainer: The Science Behind Post-Brushing Cold Water Sensation
projects.outcome:

Successfully leveraged AI tools to dissect and synthesize intricate scientific information (e.g., thermoreception mechanisms) into clear, accessible, and engaging narratives, making complex topics understandable for a general audience.

projects.description:
Project Goal: Demystifying Science for Public Engagement
This project aimed to visually deliver engaging scientific insights on curious everyday phenomena, making complex scientific knowledge accessible and easily understandable for a broad audience.

AI-Driven Scientific Script Generation (ChatGPT)
Leveraging ChatGPT, I prompted the AI to generate a scientifically accurate explanation for the chosen topic, structured specifically as a concise,1 minute video script.

Multimedia Synthesis & Iterative Visual Creation (Vrew & Whisk)
The AI-generated script was then converted into a synchronized voice-over and subtitles using Vrew. Simultaneously, Whisk was employed for iterative generation of visually suitable images and video segments that perfectly complemented the narrative flow.
projects.challenges:
Iterative AI Generation for Visual Fidelity:
Overcoming inherent AI limitations in generating precise or ideal visual assets (images and video) required extensive iterative regeneration and meticulous human review, leading to significant time investment in securing suitable and high-quality visual content.

Abstract Scientific Concept Visualization:
Representing abstract scientific and chemical concepts, such as the neurological impact of menthol, posed a considerable challenge in terms of developing compelling and comprehensible visual metaphors for a lay audience.

Seamless Subtitle & Narrative Synchronization:
Ensuring seamless synchronization and contextual accuracy of subtitles with the video's dynamic narrative flow and pacing proved demanding, requiring precise linguistic and timing adjustments during post-production to enhance viewer comprehension.

projects.title: Pure JavaScript Scroll-Based Web Animation
projects.outcome:
Engineered a dynamic, scroll-based web animation and parallax effect entirely with pure JavaScript, leveraging functional programming paradigms and a modular architecture (import/export) for enhanced maintainability and extensibility, allowing for diverse animation sequences across sections. 

 Performance was significantly optimized through a custom, interrupt-driven scroll-detection function, intelligently triggering animations only when specific sections enter the viewport, thereby minimizing computational overhead. 

This project showcases advanced DOM manipulation, efficient browser rendering, UI/UX design principles, and superior user engagement.
projects.description:
Designed and implemented a dynamic web page featuring smooth, scroll-triggered animations and parallax effects entirely with pure JavaScript, showcasing advanced DOM manipulation and event handling capabilities.

Optimized performance for fluid visual transitions by developing a custom, interrupt-driven scroll-detection function that intelligently triggers animations only when specific sections enter the viewport,
minimizing unnecessary computations. Demonstrated a strong grasp of efficient browser rendering, UI/UX design principles, and user engagement.
process: Universal Scroll Animation & Detection Function Development (utilizing Linear Interpolation)
projects.challenges:
Significant challenges included dynamically setting distinct animation start points for various sections with a unified function, precisely calculating the animation range for each, and accurately determining scrollbar width to prevent layout disruptions. Optimizing the code structure for increasing sections and implementing separate animation behaviors for mobile environments also proved difficult. 

These complexities were overcome through extensive research into existing implementations and a dedicated effort to develop an optimized, universally applicable function that intelligently manages animation across all sections.

projects.title: Vite-like Frontend Development Framework
projects.outcome:
Streamlined frontend development environment setup via concise CLI commands. This project leverages high-performance tools such as esbuild, SWC, and Bun to achieve significantly faster development and deployment. 

 Specifically, esbuild offers approximately 100 times faster build performance than Webpack, Bun delivers over twofold benchmark performance compared to Node.js, and SWC processes code roughly 20 times faster than Babel. 

Usability is further enhanced through an intuitive command-line interface and comprehensive, step-by-step guidance.
projects.description:
Developed a Vite-like frontend framework (NPM library) with React and
esbuild, achieving over 100x faster build speeds than Webpack for
optimized project setup, development, and deployment.

Integrated built-in testing functionality and an intuitive CLI, providing
colored, step-by-step guidance for an enhanced developer experience.
process: High-Performance Build System Integration (esbuild, SWC, Bun)
projects.challenges:
Initially, comprehending the mechanism for publishing an npm library to be globally downloadable by users was challenging due to a lack of prior experience. Designing intuitive CLI command names and a step-by-step UI was also demanding. Integrating unfamiliar tools like esbuild, SWC, and Bun cohesively posed another significant hurdle. These issues were systematically addressed through thorough documentation review, incremental feature implementation, and extensive experimentation. 

The most formidable challenge involved relaying esbuild's CLI-only error messages to the browser, which necessitated developing a WebSocket server for development and arduously integrating it with esbuild through persistent trial and error, even with AI assistance.

projects.title: Custom JavaScript UI Library (React-like)
projects.outcome:
A custom React-like UI library was engineered using pure JavaScript without relying on a virtual DOM, enabling faster response times and simpler operation by directly manipulating the browser’s DOM API for element creation, querying, updating, and removal. 

A key advantage is its recursive DOM creation capability, allowing DOM elements to be nested dynamically for enhanced scalability and extensibility. 

Additionally, a lightweight Jest-inspired testing utility was developed from scratch to ensure library stability. Integration with Firebase showcased proficiency in real-time data persistence and asynchronous cloud backend interaction.
projects.description:
Engineered a custom React-like UI library using pure JavaScript,
implementing core functionalities like component lifecycle, state
management, custom component creation, reactive UI updates and robust
client-side routing with custom history management to ensure seamless
browser navigation (forward/back) through state tracking.

Integrated Firebase Database for real-time data persistence, showcasing
experience with cloud-based backend services and asynchronous data
handling.

Developed a custom, Jest-like testing utility from scratch to ensure
library stability and demonstrate proficiency in testing framework principles.
projects.challenges:
During the project, a major challenge was implementing extensibility by recursively generating DOM elements using the same function. This was resolved by applying a recursive approach. Simplifying the complex Jest-like testing utility involved distilling core functionalities into concise functions to improve efficiency. 

For client-side routing, detecting whether the user navigated forward or backward in the browser history was difficult. To address this, a state property was added to the window object to track navigation, and for cases where the user did not navigate backward or forward, window.history.pushState was used to record the visited URLs.

projects.title: Full-stack Web App Boilerplate
projects.outcome:
Docker containerization optimized development and deployment workflows by ensuring a consistent runtime environment. Specifically, the system was configured to orchestrate frontend, backend, database, and Nginx services seamlessly with a single command, significantly reducing setup complexity and execution overhead. 

Additionally, the backend employed worker threads to leverage multi-core CPU capabilities efficiently, enhancing server scalability. These implementations collectively improved development productivity, system scalability, and integration.
projects.description:
Developed a Docker-containerized full-stack boilerplate (React,
Node.js/Express, Nginx) with environment-specific Webpack
configurations, streamlining development and deployment workflows.

Engineered the Node.js backend utilizing worker threads (multi-threading)
for enhanced server scalability and efficient multi-core CPU utilization.
projects.challenges: Major challenges included unclear integration of the entire technology stack, designing an efficient project folder structure, and correctly configuring paths within Docker files. To address these issues, extensive research was conducted using online resources, followed by incremental implementation and iterative troubleshooting through trial and error. This methodical approach enabled steady progress and successful resolution of technical obstacles.

projects.title: Sustainable Design Project: Recycled Plastic Korean-Aesthetic Stand Lamp
projects.outcome:
User-Centric Value & Educational Impact:

This stand lamp is thoughtfully designed for students and children with an appreciation for Korean culture, catering to their daily study needs. Its energy-efficient and long-lasting LED technology ensures durability and cost-effectiveness. The main body, inspired by distinct Korean characters (e.g., "ㅂ," "ㅅ," "ㅁ"), culturally resonates with users. Furthermore, the transparent frame purposefully exposes internal electronic circuits, serving as an engaging educational tool that sparks curiosity and understanding in young users.

Sustainable & Environmental Impact:

Embodying strong eco-design principles, the lamp is conceptualized for production using recyclable plastics such as PET or HDPE, thereby significantly minimizing environmental impact and product waste. The integration of energy-efficient, long-lasting LED lighting further contributes to reduced energy consumption and a diminished ecological footprint from frequent replacements, aligning with a long-term sustainability vision.
projects.description:
Sustainable Product Design & Market Validation: 
Designed a Koreanaesthetic stand lamp using recycled plastic, prioritizing eco-design principles and validating its market feasibility through comprehensive research on existing stand lamp types and pricing (e.g., IKEA) and detailed cost analysis, including material sourcing and logistics (e.g. international shipping fees from China)

User-Centered Prototyping with Technical Implementation:
Orchestrated the full design process, from ideation through material selection, usage scenarios, and human-scale considerations. Personally coded a functional Arduino-based prototype (acrylic) featuring
interactive light and sound activation.
projects.challenges:
1. Fabrication & Prototyping Limitations:

Challenge: Fabricating the transparent acrylic enclosure, particularly cutting its thick material and creating precise square apertures, was challenging due to limited and conventional tooling available in the school workshop. 

Solution: Overcame tooling constraints by meticulously drilling initial circular openings and then manually shaping them into the desired square forms.

2. Aesthetic & Educational Integration of Electronics:

Challenge: Integrating Arduino circuitry and wiring aesthetically within a transparent enclosure was a significant hurdle. The design intended to visually expose the circuit for educational and curiosity purposes for children, necessitating an exceptionally clean and visually appealing wiring layout that initially seemed difficult to achieve. 

Solution: Leveraged prior experience in desktop PC assembly to meticulously organize and route the internal wiring, ensuring both functionality and a clean, appealing visual presentation through the transparent frame.

3. Optimizing LED Placement for Distinct Projection:

Challenge: Achieving the key feature of projecting clear Korean characters onto a surface in low-light conditions required precise LED height and position calibration. Determining the optimal arrangement for sharp, legible projection proved complex. 

Solution: Through an iterative process of experimentation and multiple adjustments to LED placement and height, the ideal configuration was identified to successfully project distinct Korean characters.

projects.title: Emergency Solar + Hand Crank Powered Cooking Station Design
projects.outcome:
1. Realization of a Distinct Design Philosophy:

Successfully integrated Marc Newson's core design philosophies into the product, manifesting in a futuristic aesthetic, biomorphic forms, all-in-one functionality, streamlined contours, interdisciplinary integration, and an overarching commitment to simplicity. This approach ensured a cohesive and impactful product identity.

2. Holistic Product & Mechanical Design:

Beyond external aesthetics, a comprehensive internal operational mechanism was co-designed, ensuring the product's functional viability.

Strategic material selection (durable, corrosion-resistant, high-temperature tolerant) was prioritized for robust outdoor performance, incorporating transparent components to visually showcase the internal workings.

Applied color theory principles for mood board development and the selection of a cohesive color palette, enhancing visual appeal and functional clarity.

3. Enhanced User Experience & Ergonomic Integration:

Developed a detailed interaction design that clearly defines user sequences and operational methodologies for intuitive product engagement.

Incorporated interface design considerations for the integrated display, optimizing information hierarchy and accessibility.

Prioritized user convenience and safety through careful ergonomic studies, optimizing product and component sizing while minimizing potential user risks.

An Ergonomic Study explored various user postures and usage scenarios, identifying both the product's limitations and its potential for future iterative enhancements.

4. Innovative & Resourceful Prototyping:

Achieved cost-effective and rapid concept prototyping by employing the kitbashing technique, utilizing secondhand toys to construct physical models that closely resembled the conceptual design. This allowed for quick physical validation of form and scale.
projects.description:
Marc Newson-Inspired, Sustainable Product Design: 
Led the design of an emergency solar and hand-crank powered cooking station,conceptualized with Marc Newson's philosophy using recycled materials and kitbashing to address critical power and cooking needs in off-grid situations.

Comprehensive User-Centered Development: 
Directed a full design process, encompassing mood boarding, material exploration, rendering,and both conceptual/final model prototyping, prioritizing user convenience and safety through an Ergonomic Study for an intuitive solution.
projects.challenges:
1. Integrating Abstract Design Philosophy:

Challenge: Translating the highly abstract design philosophy of Marc Newson into a tangible and functional product proved to be a significant challenge.

Solution: This was addressed by commencing with an in-depth analysis and extensive sketching of Newson's existing works to deeply internalize his core principles. This foundational understanding then continuously guided the iterative development of my design sketches, ensuring consistent adherence to his unique design ethos throughout the process.

2. Defining Optimal Generator Mechanism:

Challenge: Initial research revealed a vast array of generator mechanisms and forms, leading to significant indecision regarding the most suitable option for the emergency cooking station.

Solution: I overcame this by engaging in extensive consultations with my professor, rigorously defining the specific target users, their potential use-case scenarios, environmental contexts, and crucial constraints. This user-centric clarification allowed for decisive selections concerning the generator's form, mechanism, size, and weight, ensuring alignment with defined user needs.

3. Evolving Undefined Concepts:

Challenge: Developing a singular, cohesive design concept and evolving early sketches was particularly difficult due to the initially open-ended nature of the project. The absence of strict predefined constraints meant the design had to be organically transformed from abstract ideas.

Solution: This demanded a continuous, unconstrained ideation and iteration process, where abstract forms were steadily refined into a concrete and visually coherent product vision, driven purely by conceptual exploration.

4. Conceptualizing Internal Mechanisms from Sketches:

Challenge: Bridging the gap between the finalized external product sketch and its potential internal operational mechanism presented a complex problem. Visualizing how the design would functionally operate was not immediately intuitive.

Solution: I conducted comprehensive online research into various gear types and mechanical principles. Furthermore, I acquired similar secondhand toy models, meticulously disassembled them, and reverse-engineered their functionalities to inform the internal mechanical design and subsequent sketches.

5. Sourcing Prototyping Components through Kitbashing:

Challenge: Finding commercially available toys that perfectly matched the specific forms and proportions of my design sketches for physical prototyping proved nearly impossible.

Solution: This required extensive visits to secondhand toy stores, where I selectively acquired toys that possessed individual components closely resembling my sketched parts. These relevant sections were then carefully disassembled and creatively reassembled (kitbashed) to construct a physical representation akin to my envisioned design.
